notes.subject: יזובו
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'ol i flow we olsem wara'; Tok Pisin 'smusmu we' em i klostu long piksa bilong bodi i lusim strong

notes.subject: מתנובת שדי
notes.rationale: Sampla i ridim 'long no kaikai bilong gaden' (wantaim), narapela 'long kaikai bilong gaden' — bihainim 'min' (wantaim/bilong)

notes.subject: long wanem
notes.rationale: שהם־יזובו i no gat 'bilong wanem' stret, tasol sentens i nidim blain

translation: Ol man ol bainat i bagarapim i gutpela moa long ol man hangre i bagarapim: long wanem, ol dispela i smusmu we, ol i bagarapim olgeta, long no kaikai bilong gaden.

tokens.gloss: long ol man ol i bagarapim
